study: post-hoc metadata baseline extension of E3
retrieval: Same full query text; fixed character-bigram BM25 or exact cosine from an explicitly identified embedding service; category filter BEFORE top-5. No filter fallback for unresolved metadata. All categories authorized in utility experiment; denied scopes tested separately.
metadata: Parse only successfully resolved replacement markers from the same processing pipeline, using service directory and detected spans; never use gold person organization. One metadata level per condition.
membership: Stratified observation model: attacker knows one category filter matching the document. Score only documents having exactly one resolved category, disclose exposure fraction. This is a visibility-conditioned risk estimate, not the empirical frequency of top-5 exposure. No claim about hidden metadata or query logs remaining secret.
qa: Not measured in this extension; authorized metadata QA is a separate task and can disclose organization.
uncertainty: Mean and range across the same three fictional worlds; no population confidence intervals or policy selection.
scope: Synthetic follow-up, not untouched real-world validation, NPU measurement, or production access-control assurance. Embedding execution is incomplete until actual vectors are supplied.
